title: Start a session on demand and run code in the cloud
description:
As the student, I want to press Run and have the backend wake up, so that I never pay for idle servers.

Feature: On-demand cloud session
  Scenario: First run after idle
    Given no Fargate task is running
    When the student starts a session through the control endpoint
    Then a task starts and the session becomes ready
    And running a hello-world project through the proxy streams its output
  Scenario: Backend scales to zero
    Given a session with no activity past the idle timeout
    Then no Fargate task is running

comments.author: home
comments.text: Deployed; control and proxy return 401 without a token. Waiting on a real session start and SSE stream.

right_now_summary: The service is deployed, but a real session start and SSE output stream still need testing.
